I am writing this to warn other pet owners, especially those with male cats. This clinic showed complete negligence, prioritizing future visits over my cat's immediate safety.On January 14, I brought my male cat here because he was in visible pain while urinating and started peeing around the apartment. The urinalysis results showed a highly alkaline pH of 7.5 and an extremely concentrated Specific Gravity of 1.061. Anyone with a veterinary degree knows that this is a ticking time bomb for a male cat—a perfect environment for struvite crystals to form and cause a deadly blockage.Instead of immediately putting him on a strict prescription urinary diet to dissolve the crystals, the vet here completely brushed it off. They prescribed Gabapentin for pain and told me, "We might think about a diet sometime in the future, just monitor him." They masked his pain for a few days but left the root cause to worsen.Exactly two months later, on March 14, my cat suffered a full, life-threatening urethral obstruction. We ended up at VEG Emergency Care, where my cat had to be sedated, catheterized, and hospitalized under intensive care for 36 hours. The bill was exactly $5,000.This emergency and the extreme stress my cat went through could have been easily prevented if this clinic had acted on his January labs. They chose to do nothing, seemingly waiting for the condition to escalate so I would have to come back and spend more money. If your pet has urinary issues, do not trust this place. Go somewhere else where vets actually care about preventative medicine and saving animals' lives

Decided to switch to Heart of Harlem after my vet moved for an annual visit and vaccinations for my pup. Dr. Sola and his team were super friendly and patient (very anxious pup). Affordable prices and great care. Would definitely recommend their services.
❤️ this place

Extremely long wait times even with appointment, extremely high quote (over $1000) stating my cat needs every test under the sun despite being listed as a low cost vet. Also be careful using cherry (pay over time) it was 35.99% plus 3% credit card fee bordering extortion. At least the doc was knowledgeable but seems performative to excuse the cost.

Update: they doxed my cat in their response.  If I could take away my 1 star I would for that!
Keep up your great customer service.

Best clinic especially for bully breeds. My Rottweiler is so beloved by the staff and treated so kindly by everyone. Staff is so understanding of rescues and they have a limit for how much stress they put on a dog: my dog had a nasty ear infection that went unnoticed for months at the shelter and they only tried 3 times before seeing she was getting incredibly stressed, then allowed decompression time, skipped the more hands on steps to reduce stress and went for less invasive measures. I could not be more appreciative. They not only take care of my baby’s physical health but emotional health as well. And every time I come in she is treated like a queen. The front desk people LOVE her and we love them. My Lemonade insurance works so perfectly with this office if you’re in need of recommendations.

I've been coming to this place for the last 10 years and the treatment that they give Mike that is awesome I have no complaint the love it is so much that one I go there my dog is so happy just walking in and being there

After years of searching for the right vet, I finally found one at Heart of Harlem. I walked in worried that Lemon had a UTI because she stopped using her litter box, but left with peace of mind after learning it was simply a behavioral issue. Apparently, Lemon had decided that sharing a litter box with her sister was beneath her, because cats always have their reasons!
I appreciated the team's kindness, thoroughness, and transparency, including providing an itemized estimate before any services were performed.
Thank you, Jasmine, Daphney, Franco, Dr. Sola, and the entire staff for taking such great care of Lemon and me.

This was my former vet. I left when every single visit within a calendar year they demanded a "diagnostic exam" of $110.

When I went in for the annual check up, I got one, along with a Lyme disease vaccine that required a booster a few months later. When I went in for that booster, they said that my dog could not get the booster without another diagnostic despite having had one 2 months before.

Fast forward to this summer where my dog got a minor surgery up in VT in which his sutures came out while in transit back to NYC. When I asked for his foot to be taken care of due to possible infection, they did take me in, but... not without a diagnostic first. I had forwarded the paperwork from the surgery to HoH, so there was no mystery going on here.

3 diagnostics in way less than a year? No, thanks. Moving on. Please stop with the extortion of our pets. 2 stars and not 1, because despite this BS policy, I like the people there.
Has been incredibly helpful and transparent as I'm taking care of my cat during a severe medical emergency. All the staff is wonderful.

Dr. Solas, all staff- including sub vets for when Dr. Solas is on vacation, have been kind, communicative, and empathetic.
The quality of care is priceless ♡
The team at this Veterinary Clinic is wonderful to work with, they’re quite caring in their approach in all matters with my 2 year old pup.

The nursing system uses a manipulative approach towards you and your pet, which is untrustworthy. They try to put you through unnecessary checkups and tests that your pet doesn't actually need, trying to instill fear in order to extract your money. It was a disappointing experience. My puppy is young, a year and a half old, and I took him for his annual vaccinations, his second time getting them.

The first time here, I had to tell the nurse that I was only bringing him for his annual vaccinations and nothing else because she had already entered a series of blood tests and heartworm tests, among other things, into the computer without consulting me. The bill was already approaching $500. I had already had an abusive experience at another clinic called BRILLIANT VETERINARY Care, 641 Amsterdam Ave, NY, NY. I took my puppy there because he had stopped eating and playing. He's very playful, and they charged me $1014 just to tell me he had eaten something that upset his stomach. They prescribed probiotics and a soft food, all included in the tests they performed. According to them, they don't care about your budget; they keep adding things...
Continuing with the issue, I had to bring my puppy to this Heart of Harlem clinic for his 6-week follow-up buster vaccine. So, they called me and I asked how much this vaccine cost. The nurse who called me said $78. When I arrived, they charged me $153 and told me the doctor had to check him before giving him the vaccine. I told them, "But my puppy is fine, he's happy. I just came to complete his vaccination. The doctor already examined him 6 weeks ago." When I complained, the doctor never came. You seem like a different person. A nurse came who wasn't dressed as a nurse; she looked like a dictator. When I was complaining to the receptionists, she came out and stood there without letting them explain. Her face said, "I don't know what to tell you." She was the same one who was talking to me about treatments to check for heartworms—a bunch of strange things. Her attitude towards the nurse was like a gunman's, very unpleasant, with a completely unconventional appearance for someone who works out of love for animals and clients. I do NOT recommend this place at all. I also don't recommend the area. The place is limited for people who can't climb stairs.
Great service but a little slow. Our appt was at 4:20 We saw the doctor around 5:15.

I've been taking my dog, Parker, to Heart of Harlem for about a year now and love it! The staff is so nice, and the doctors are thorough and kind. Pricing is lower than I used to pay elsewhere and very reasonable, in my opinion. We see Dr. Youssef, and he is AMAZING. Always answers all of my many, many questions in the office and over the phone when I inevitably forget to ask in person. My dog just had to have TPLO (knee) surgery at the Hospital for Veterinary Surgery (referred to by Dr. Youssef), and a day later, HoH called me to see how her surgery went. They already had the results from HVS and called to see if I had any questions (which of course I did) and to wish my dog well. Dr. Youssef called me back a day later (as the receptionist told me he would) with answers to my questions. He left a voicemail since I was away from my phone, and also sent an email summarizing it. Everyone from the people at the front desk to the vet techs to the doctors is very communicative, kind, and accommodating, and truly cares about my dog. In the past year, since moving to the area and switching to HoH, a lot has happened with my dog, and I'm so glad that HoH and Dr. Youssef are the ones helping us through it all!
